description: Vector for security invariant 8 (docs/SDK-ROADMAP.md): test traffic cannot silently become production traffic. SPEC.md §5 assigns the enforcement error LCP-013 TEST_TRAFFIC_POLICY (test envelope flag vs X-LCP-Test header disagreement, test traffic at a production endpoint, non-test traffic at a sandbox). SDK GAP (verified at 3d4bc9ab): the Python SDK exposes no verifier-side production/sandbox mode state — webhook.verify_http_request is mode-agnostic and LCPClient only *emits* the X-LCP-Test header on the send side (client.py _headers). Per this suite's contract, invariant 8 is not exercisable by an SDK primitive; enforcement lives in the reference platform. The vector is published so SDKs that DO expose a production-mode verifier can set sdk_exercisable: true in their lane's copy/report, and runners MUST surface the skip loudly (never a silent pass).

vectors.description: A production-mode verifier must refuse an envelope with message.test = true. Expected reject outcome LCP-013 if (when) an SDK exposes mode state.
vectors.gap_note: Invariant 8 not exercisable by the Python SDK — the SDK exposes no production-mode verifier state (webhook.verify_http_request is mode-agnostic; X-LCP-Test is send-side only). Platform concern (reference platform enforces LCP-013 per SPEC.md §5).
